def transform(grid):
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and len(row) > 1 and row[0] not in (2,4,5,6,7,9))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    base = min(set(v for row in top for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in top for x in row))
    # background is the most frequent color in the upper panel
    base = max(set(v for row in top for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(x==v for row in top for x in row))
    return [[3 if a==b else base for a,b in zip(r,s)] for r,s in zip(top,bottom)]
